data.long_meaning: The name Amzad is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two roots: ‘Am’ meaning joy, and ‘Zad’ meaning radiant. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amzad usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
